summary: Final pre-closeout acceptance PASS. All configured gates green at HEAD (ee3b409e) after a trivial test-file fix applied by this role. The adversarial-testing commit 0516c427 introduced a synthetic '?lock-miss' query-suffix dynamic import in rate-limit-cleanup-adversarial.test.ts that broke tsc --noEmit and the tsc build for @reading-advantage/auth (TS2307). This regression was not caught by measure-phase-acceptance (whose baseline 0d426d85 predates the adversarial commit, so its typecheck/build PASS claims were honest for that SHA) nor by measure-adversarial-testing (which ran only scoped vitest tests, not tsc/build). Final-acceptance caught it, fixed it with the canonical vi.resetModules() pattern (commit ee3b409e), and re-verified all gates. FR-1 through FR-7 are implemented and verified against source + tests. AC 9 (DB-backed integration tests) is correctly deferred:infra (IR-1/INFRA-2 drizzle-kit migrate global-setup failure); the captcha trigger is covered by the green unit suite and the integration suite is authored. AC 11 (science-advantage build) is out of scope per the task instructions; the in-scope auth+api builds pass. Phase 9 closeout remains [~] with A6-guarded language: F-403/F-407 are NOT marked Resolved in tech-debt.md and must not be until the INFRA-2 integration tests are green.

fixes_applied_by_acceptance.description: The adversarial-testing commit 0516c427 used a synthetic '?lock-miss' query-suffix dynamic import (line 160) to bust vitest's module cache for the lock-miss probe. tsc 5.9.3 (moduleResolution: bundler) rejects the synthetic suffix with TS2307, breaking both 'tsc --noEmit' (PROJECT_CHECKS) and the 'tsc' build (PROJECT_BUILD) for @reading-advantage/auth. Replaced the query-suffix hack with the canonical vi.resetModules() + plain dynamic import() pattern. The lock-miss path is still exercised (createPrivilegedDb mocked to return acquired:false). 15/15 adversarial cleanup probes still pass; auth typecheck + build now exit 0.
fixes_applied_by_acceptance.why_not_caught_earlier: measure-phase-acceptance ran at baseline 0d426d85, which predates the adversarial commit 0516c427 — its typecheck/build PASS claims were honest for that SHA. measure-adversarial-testing ran only scoped vitest tests (89/89 green) and did not run tsc/build, so the regression slipped through. This is exactly the gap final-acceptance is designed to catch.
